In 6-8 m at Beaufort Inlet, North Carolina, as recorded during the excavations: a low mound of ballast stones over a section of the lower hull, concreted iron guns heaped on and around it, four large anchors. Most of the guns, the anchors and hundreds of thousands of objects have since been raised and conserved. The layout and the heading (not published here: 0) are approximate. model_built.glb: Blackbeard's ship as she was in 1718. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
